metadata.why: To create a cool campaign shoot
metadata.description: Tripster by Fastback is for the modern traveller. We brought it to life through travel journals, souvenirs, and ticket stubs, creating a dreamy sequence with a song that stays with you.
metadata.whatWeDid: Linkboard is a bold, fun Framer template for creatives who want a simple but eye-catching way to share their online presence. It features flexible modules for links, projects, and testimonials, and easy customisation of images, colours, and type to suit any personal brand.
